name: Can a walk-in bathtub be installed in a mobile or manufactured home?

mainEntity.name: Can a walk-in bathtub be installed in a mobile or manufactured home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in tubs can be installed in manufactured and mobile homes, but they require careful evaluation of structural floor framing. Mobile homes often feature lighter floor joists that must be reinforced to support several hundred pounds of water and tub weight. Furthermore, plumbing runs and drain locations in manufactured home crawlspaces differ from traditional slab or basement foundations. HH Remodeling provides specialized mobile home repair and accessibility modifications, evaluating floor support beams and coordinating properly sized plumbing before installation begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but floor joists often require custom structural reinforcement to bear the water weight, along with mobile-home-specific plumbing and drain coordination.
